mapper.select: select ds.ID DOR_STAFF_ID, db.ID,db.BED_NUMBER,ds.STAFF_BADGE,ds.STAFF_NAME, ds.STAFF_SEX,ds.CREATE_TIME in_time,ds.DEP_NAME,ds.JOB_NAME,db.ID BED_ID, (select STATUS from SMT_STAFF staff where staff.ID=ds.STAFF_ID) as staffStatus from SMT_DORMITORY_BED db left join SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF ds on db.ID=ds.BED_ID where db.ROOM_ID=#{roomId} order by db.ID asc
